description: Table access, converted from the old engine's table_access corpus. Old configs map as: no YAML -> `legacy` (default read); YAML_CONFIG -> `yaml` with schema-qualified keys; the old harness's guardrails were inert, so both allow schema changes. Old scope_max_access=read -> caller scopes ["db:main:read"].
